verdict: Organic presence is holding; paid channels are fully off across all locations.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, no paid media ran — zero spend on Meta and Google Ads for the full 28 days, meaning no paid leads were generated. Your business profile and organic search are carrying all visible demand: combined Google Business Profile actions totaled 401 this period (23 calls, 257 direction requests, 121 website clicks), with O'Hare Precision's profile showing a modest week-over-week gain. O'Hare's search click volume has softened over the last week, and we're monitoring it closely for any ranking shifts. The paid channels will need to be reactivated to resume lead generation; organic signals alone cannot drive the volume a leadgen program requires.
